title: 第5章 开头难啊第6章 美味当前
lines: 第5章开头难啊
盛夏托着腮，一边专注听着，一边看着米丽将鱼洗干净，剖成两半，抹了一遍料酒，垫葱姜蒸上，洗干净手再烤上酥油螺丝饼，开始切笋丝香菇丝，葱丝姜丝，切好烫好，打开烤箱将饼翻个面，鱼也蒸好了。
米丽叮叮咚咚一番话刚好说完，端了鱼出来，拎起来鱼尾轻轻一抖，鱼骨鱼头等一概不要，只余两块净肉，将鱼肉轻轻拨散，再细细挑了一遍鱼刺，抽出鱼皮切成细丝。拿了只红铜小深锅过来，放上荤油炝好葱姜，倒了半锅高汤进去，再将笋丝香菇丝倒进去，等高汤烧开的功夫，一边调味儿，一边接着道：“老曹说，那个卫桓，肯定是哪家名门大派有背景有来头的子弟，我也这么觉得。我跟老曹说，那个黄云生手里有固元丹，好象还有不少。”
米丽笑起来，“老曹那双小眼，当时就蹭蹭放光了，别的我就没再多说，只留了话，要是有便宜的固元丹，让他捎个话给我。”
固元丹对躲在人界的妖来说，是必不可少的宝贝。
人界对化形之后的妖极端不友好，灵气稀薄不说，还穷，妖界漫山遍野的灵芝，到了人界就成了天材地宝，化形后躲在人界的妖，几乎无法修炼，如果一直不返回妖界修炼，最后就只能耗尽寿元而死。
固元丹这东西，一粒可以帮助妖们延长五十年、甚至一百年的寿数，吃的多了，修为都可以有所增进，当然增进的非常非常少。
固元丹在妖界，据说很勉强才能算进好东西堆里，很不值钱，到了人界，之所以极其珍贵，是因为从妖界到人界的妖们，除了和本命炼在一起的法宝，别的什么也带不过来。
流传在人界的固元丹，基本上都是修真界到妖界修行试炼的各大门派弟子辗转运过来的，通过各大门派在人界办事处倒卖出来，粒粒都是天价。
猪妖老曹不靠那间酒吧挣钱，他挣钱的路子有两条，一是贩卖各种不保证真假的消息，第二，就是倒卖固元丹。
固元丹的销路不愁，可来源却少，老曹七成的心思，都用在怎么搞到固元丹上，黄云生和他那个老板有不少固元丹这事，老曹肯定不会放过，指定要挖空心思打听到那个卫桓的来历，看看有没有可乘之机。
高汤烧开了，米丽放了大半勺黄酒，倒进鱼肉和调料汁儿，薄薄勾了芡，将打散的蛋黄细细倒进去，看着淡黄的细丝随着微滚的汤翻上来，关了火，淋上半勺香醋，本来就鲜香无比的鱼羹顿时如画龙点了睛一般，香味儿扑的盛夏口水涌了满嘴。
米丽盛了碗鱼羹端给盛夏，再拿出烤的金黄酥脆的酥油螺丝饼，放到碟子里，递到盛夏面前。
盛夏低下头，深吸了口鱼羹的鲜香味儿，没能打听到什么有用消息的郁闷，被这股香味儿冲的立刻烟消云散了。
黄云生找到米丽，报了三粒固元丹的价，原本以为对方必定两眼放光口水横流，立刻就得答应了，谁知道从他进去到走，那只狐狸精的嘴角一路往下，就没上来过。
黄云生深受打击回去，提着颗心跟老大卫桓禀报了，等了两三天，米丽这边半点回音没有，黄云生只好开了车出来，等在菜市场不远，眼看米丽买菜出来，忙开车跟上去。
车子跟到米丽身边，黄云生从车里探出头，“米小姐。”
“是你啊。”米丽撇了眼黄云生，不等他问，直接了当道：“那珠子小夏喜欢得很，不卖。”
“唉我说，一个小丫头片子，还是你养大的，你就这么由着她？咱们是自己人，我跟你说，我可是一口价直接到顶，一丁点儿折扣没打。我跟你说，那东西我们老板不是非要不可，过了这个村，是真没那个店，三粒！三粒啊！”
黄云生冲米丽竖着三根指头拼命摇，“我跟你说……”
“我不由着她，难道由着你？不卖就是不卖，赶紧走吧，你瞧你这车开的，把路都堵上了。”米丽打断黄云生的话，往旁边几步，走到行道树里面去了。
“哎！我跟你说，你……”黄云生半截身子都伸出车窗了，一句话没喊完，就被后面一片汽车喇叭声打断，眼看米丽头也不回，还加快了脚步，黄云生先拧头往后骂了句，缩头回去，一脚油门走了。
进了九月，天气凉爽起来，黄云生再没来过。关于卫桓，老曹那边半丝信儿也没打听到。宋家那间小破侦探社别说大案，连个查外遇捉奸的小案子也没接到。给周凯留的信息在论坛挂了一个来月了，一丝回音儿没有。
所有的事都没有进展，盛夏倒不怎么着急，万事开头难，象这样开头难的时候，不是十回八回了。
再说，又到了秋风起，蟹脚痒的时候了，每年这个时候，盛夏心情都格外的好。
吃了早饭，米丽开车赶去蟹湖挑刚捞出水的螃蟹，盛夏晃到店里开了门，将从旧货市场淘来的一堆破烂摊在桌子上，一件件清理。
一直整理到屋角的落地自鸣钟慢吞吞敲响，盛夏站起来，伸了个懒腰，将整理好的物件儿挂上价签，放到货架上，洗了手，推开纱门出来，正锁门，身后一个微带磁性的男声响起，“请问，这里有位米小姐吗？”
盛夏回头，一张英俊到让人眼的脸上笑容灿烂，迎上盛夏的目光，英俊男子伸手拿下头上的巴拿马草帽，按在胸前，冲盛夏绅士无比的微一欠身。
“米丽吗？”盛夏打量着周凯，想笑又忍住。
周凯点头。
“米丽是我小姨。”盛夏锁好门，转身笑渞。
“你是盛夏？”周凯一脸夸张的惊讶赞叹，打量着盛夏，“怪不得你小姨一提到你，就一脸骄傲，果然是美貌与智慧兼具，我姓林，林冬。”
盛夏哈的一声，“米姨叫米丽，你头一回见她，就叫麦俊，我叫盛夏，你现在又改叫凌冬了？”
周凯一个怔神，举起巴拿马草帽作势往脸上掩了下，躬身弯腰，笑出了声，“太丢人了，幸亏这里就你和我，丢人也没丢到外面去。”
（本章完）

Chapter 5 The beginning is difficult
Shengxia cupped her cheeks and listened intently while watching Mili wash the fish, cut it in half, apply cooking wine, steam it with onion and ginger, wash her hands and bake the buttered screw cake. She started cutting shredded bamboo shoots, shredded mushrooms, shredded green onion and ginger, cut and blanched them, turned on the oven, turned the cake over, and the fish was steamed.
Mi Li just finished speaking. She took the fish out, picked up the fish tail and shook it gently. There were no fish bones or heads, leaving only two pieces of clean meat. She gently scattered the fish meat, carefully picked out the fish bones, pulled out the fish skin and cut it into thin strips. He brought a small deep copper pot over, put some meat oil on it to simmer the onions and ginger, poured half a pot of broth into it, and then poured in shredded bamboo shoots and shiitake mushrooms. While the broth was boiling, he seasoned and continued: "Old Cao said that Wei Huan must be a descendant of a well-known family with a good background. I think so too. I told Lao Cao that Huang Yunsheng has Guyuan Dan in his hand, and there seems to be a lot more."
Mi Li laughed, "Lao Cao's little eyes shone right then. I didn't say much else. I just left a message. If there is a cheap Gu Yuan Dan, let him send it to me."
Guyuan Dan is an indispensable treasure for demons hiding in the human world.
The human world is extremely unfriendly to demons after their transformation. Not to mention their thin spiritual energy, they are also poor. The Ganoderma lucidum that spreads all over the mountains and plains in the demon world has become a treasure in the human world. The demons who hide in the human world after their transformation are almost unable to practice. If they do not return to the demon world to practice, they will eventually run out of life and die.
One pill of Solid Yuan Pill can help demons extend their lifespan by fifty or even a hundred years. If you eat more, your cultivation will be improved, but of course the improvement will be very, very small.
In the demon world, it is said that Guyuan Dan can only be counted among the good things, and it is very worthless. In the human world, the reason why it is extremely precious is because the demons from the demon world to the human world cannot bring anything else with them except the magic weapon refined with their own destiny.
The Guyuan Pills that are circulated in the human world are basically transferred from the cultivation world to the demon world by disciples of various sects. They are resold in the offices of the human world through various sects, and every piece of them is sold at a sky-high price.
The pig demon Lao Cao does not make money from that bar. He has two ways to make money. One is selling all kinds of information that is not guaranteed to be true or false, and the other is reselling Guyuan Dan.
There is no worry about the sales of Guyuan Dan, but there are few sources. Old Cao spends 70% of his thoughts on how to get Guyuan Dan. Huang Yunsheng and his boss have a lot of Guyuan Dan. Old Cao will definitely not let it go. He is determined to find out the origin of Wei Huan and see if there is any opportunity.
When the soup was boiling, Mili put half a spoonful of rice wine, poured in the fish meat and seasoning sauce, thinly thickened the gravy, poured the beaten egg yolk in finely, watching the light yellow filaments turn up with the slightly boiling soup, turned off the heat, and poured half a spoonful of balsamic vinegar on it.
Mili filled a bowl of fish soup and brought it to Shengxia, then took out the baked golden and crispy butter screw cake, put it on a plate, and handed it to Shengxia.
Shengxia lowered her head and took a deep breath of the fresh smell of the fish soup. The depression of not being able to find out any useful information immediately disappeared due to the smell.
……………………
Huang Yunsheng found Mi Li and quoted the price of three Yuan-Guiding Pills. He originally thought that the other party's eyes would be gleaming and his mouth would be drooling, so he immediately agreed. Who knew that from the moment he walked in, the vixen's lips never came up.
Huang Yunsheng was deeply shocked and went back. He reported it to old David Huan with heartfelt feelings. After waiting for two or three days, there was no reply from Mili. Huang Yunsheng had no choice but to drive out and wait at the vegetable market not far away. When he saw Mili coming out to buy groceries, he hurriedly drove to follow her.
The car followed Mi Li, and Huang Yunsheng stuck his head out of the car, "Miss Mi."
"It's you." Mi Li glanced at Huang Yunsheng, and without waiting for him to ask, she said directly: "Xiaxia likes that bead very much and won't sell it."
"Oh, let me tell you, a little girl was raised by you, and you just let her go like this? We are our own people, and let me tell you, I paid the top price directly without any discount. Let me tell you, our boss doesn't have to buy that thing. After passing this village, there really is no such store, three pills! Three pills!"
Huang Yunsheng shook his three fingers at Mi Li, "I'm telling you..."
"I can't let her go, how can I let you? If I don't sell it, I won't sell it. Let's go quickly. Look, your car is driving and blocking the road." Mi Li interrupted Huang Yunsheng's words, took a few steps to the side and walked into the street tree.
"Hey! Let me tell you, you..." Huang Yunsheng stretched half of his body out of the car window. Before he could finish his sentence, he was interrupted by the sound of car horns from behind. Seeing that Mili didn't even look back and even quickened her pace, Huang Yunsheng turned his head and cursed, then turned back and stepped on the accelerator to leave.
……………………
In September, the weather became cooler, and Huang Yunsheng never came again. Regarding Wei Huan, Lao Cao didn't know anything about him. Not to mention major cases, the Song family's small detective agency didn't even receive a small case of investigating an affair or catching an adulterer. The message left for Zhou Kai has been on the forum for a month, but there has been no response.
Nothing has progressed, so I'm not too anxious in midsummer. Everything is difficult at the beginning, and it's not like this eight times out of ten.
Besides, it’s the time when the autumn wind blows and crab legs get itchy. At this time of year, the midsummer mood is particularly good.
After breakfast, Millie drove to the Crab Lake to pick out freshly caught crabs. Midsummer went to the store and opened the door. She spread a bunch of junk from the flea market on the table and cleaned them one by one.
The floor clock that had been sorted all the way to the corner of the room rang slowly. Shengxia stood up, stretched, put price tags on the items he had sorted, put them on the shelves, washed his hands, pushed open the screen door and came out. As he was locking the door, a slightly magnetic male voice behind him said, "Excuse me, is there a Miss Mi here?"
Shengxia turned around, with a bright smile on an eye-catchingly handsome face. Meeting Shengxia's gaze, the handsome man reached out and took off the Panama hat on his head, pressed it on his chest, and bowed to the gentleman Shengxia.
"Mili?" Shengxia looked at Zhou Kai, wanting to laugh but holding back.
Zhou Kai nodded.
"Mili is my aunt." Shengxia locked the door, turned around and smiled.
"Are you Shengxia?" Zhou Kai exclaimed with exaggerated surprise and looked at Shengxia, "No wonder your aunt looks proud when she mentions you. You are indeed both beautiful and intelligent. My surname is Lin, Lin Dong."
Shengxia laughed, "Aunt Mi's name is Mi Li. The first time you met her, you called her Mai Jun. My name is Shengxia. Now you've changed my name to Lingdong?"
Zhou Kai was startled, raised his Panama hat to cover his face, bowed and laughed, "It's so embarrassing. Fortunately, it's just you and me here, so the shame is not thrown outside."
(End of chapter)
